## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows `type(scope): summary` (it becomes the squash commit message)
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass locally
- [ ] `npm run build` passes (if config, dependencies, layouts or pages changed)
- [ ] Tests added or updated for changes in `src/lib/` or `src/app/api/`
- [ ] App still runs in mock mode without keys
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour changed (`README.md`, `docs/architecture.md`, `SUBMIT.md`)
- [ ] No secrets, keys or `.env*` files committed (except `.env.example`)
- [ ] New dependencies or CI/hook/lint changes are explained above
